hexverse.page.amethyst_tools.title: Amethyst Equipment
hexverse.page.amethyst_tools.tools.0: By shaping $(l:items/amethyst)$(item)Charged Amethyst$() into tools, I can create implements capable of carrying a _Hex.
hexverse.page.amethyst_tools.tools.1: После придачи $(l:items/amethyst)$(item)Charged Amethyst$() форму инструментов, я смог создать оружия, удерживающие в себе _Hex.
hexverse.page.amethyst_tools.weapons.pic: Whenever an $(item)Amethyst Pickaxe$() breaks a block, it invokes the bound spell, leaving both the block's position and identifier upon the stack.
hexverse.page.amethyst_tools.weapons.swo: An $(item)Amethyst Sword$() casts its bound _Hex whenever it strikes a creature, placing the unfortunate target upon the stack before the spell begins.
hexverse.page.amethyst_tools.armour.ches: The $(item)Chestplate$() reacts whenever I suffer harm. The direct source, indirect source, and the amount of damage are all supplied to the stack.
hexverse.page.amethyst_tools.armour.legg: The $(item)Leggings$() awaken only upon my death. Since I cannot serve as a conduit while dead, the spell consumes its own internal _media instead.
hexverse.page.amethyst_tools.armour.boot: The $(item)Boots$() respond to a sufficiently long fall, pushing the exact distance travelled onto the stack before invoking their _Hex.
hexverse.page.hex_snowballs.title: Amethyst Snowballs
hexverse.page.hex_snowballs.0: Even something as mundane as a snowball can serve as a temporary vessel for _media. By embedding fragments of amethyst within the ice, I can produce projectiles capable of invoking a bound _Hex upon impact.
hexverse.page.hex_snowballs.dust: Fashioned from $(item)Amethyst Dust$(). Holds no more _media than the dust from which it was made.
hexverse.page.hex_snowballs.shard: Fashioned from $(item)Charged Amethyst$(). Carries the same reserve of _media as a charged shard.
hexverse.page.hex_snowballs.crystal: Fashioned from an $(item)Amethyst Crystal$(). Holds a correspondingly greater quantity of _media.
hexverse.page.hex_snowballs.quenched: Fashioned from $(item)Quenched Amethyst$(). Stable, though no less potent.
hexverse.page.hex_snowballs.media: Striking an entity places it upon the stack. Striking a block instead leaves both its position and identifier. Like other casting devices, the snowball draws upon its own reservoir of _media.
hexverse.page.hex_snowballs.media2: After studying snowballs a bit deeper, I realized that they are capable of more than just storing media. They act as automated baubles, possessing their own interaction radius of about 8 blocks, and once thrown, they become completely detached from the caster. It is deeper than it seems...
hexverse.page.imbue_equipment.title: Imbue Equipment
hexverse.page.imbue_equipment.summary.0: Binds the supplied _Hex into the $(item)Amethyst Equipment$() held in my other hand. The item thereafter invokes the stored spell whenever its trigger occurs. Costs five $(item)Charged Amethyst$().
